name: Website Guy Retail Cash Manager
author: Website Guy

sections.description:
Website Guy Retail Cash Manager records branch-scoped cash-ups, denomination counts, expenses, staff signoff names, payment channels, reports, and audit log entries. It offers an optional Modern application interface alongside the default Classic interface, with independent Comfortable and Compact display-density preferences. Administrators can also use RCM Setup Transfer to move whitelisted RCM configuration between sites with a mandatory dry-run; it never transfers transactional history, WooCommerce data, passwords, or credentials.

Current active workflows include branch cash-ups, Cash Control V2 Clearing, whole-bag Cash Drop recounts, pending expected/actual channel values, cash denomination counting in cash-ups, branch standard float, cash-location setup, authoritative scoped Safe Count reconciliation, proposed and formally confirmed sealed cash drops, an immutable cash movement ledger, guarded legacy-drop migration and first-live till cutover, payment channel discrepancies, expenses, safe expense cancellation, staff signoff names, branch-scoped permissions, dashboard summaries, daily/range reports, Daily Cash-Up Breakdown, email notifications, branch-specific notification recipients, audit log, an admin-only test data reset, an admin-only staff signoff copy utility, and an admin-only guarded historical import validation/apply screen.

Movement references are displayed in the concise MOV-00001 format while stable UUID and technical references remain available internally.

Lodgement Preparation, change deliveries, generic transfers, denomination exchanges, advanced cash-control reports, and multi-till cash-ups are not active yet. Classic remains the default interface; Classic and Modern use the same operational data, permissions, and handlers.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the website-guy-retail-cash-manager folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or upload website-guy-retail-cash-manager.zip through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Website Guy Retail Cash Manager through the Plugins screen.
  3. Use the generated Cash Management page or place [websiteguy_retail_cash_manager] on a page manually.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin create WordPress users?

No. WordPress users are managed by WordPress. Staff signoff names are branch-scoped operational labels used for cash-up and expense accountability.

Does this build include denomination counts, safes, cash drops, or lodgements?

Denomination counting is active for Cash-Up cash channels, Safe Counts, and whole-bag Cash Drop recounts. New manual and denomination Cash-Ups both count the full physical drawer. Submitted V2 Safe Counts preserve their variance and reconcile expected ledger balance to the physical count through an explicit immutable movement when needed. Cash-Up Clearing, sealed Cash Drops, and Cash Drop recount reconciliation are active. Lodgements, transfers, deliveries, and denomination exchanges are not active yet.
